answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 26371 Country: India Title: While performing hajj, can a menstruating woman can perform the hajj rituals? Question: While performing hajj, can a menstruating woman can perform the hajj rituals? Answer ID: 26371 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1794/1424/B=1431) She can go everywhere including Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifa, but she cannot do tawaf. She will perform tawaf Ziyarah after she is menstruation period is over. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
